failure_summary.description: Newly supplied criteria or pending trip details were ignored or only cached results were retrieved, without applying the requested search or filter.
Fresh attraction or restaurant search results were returned without being saved to cache.
Hotel and attraction results were not joined with search_nearest despite the request relating lodging to nearby attractions.
A state abbreviation was passed as an attraction city instead of the state field.

patch.reasoning: The skill already directly instructs the agent to execute new criteria against compatible cached results, save generated results, use the state field for state abbreviations, and call search_nearest for proximity recommendations. These failures reflect noncompliance with existing guidance, and repeating it would duplicate content without addressing a documented skill gap.
